Mechanical quality gate over the TRAINABLE corpus.

positional arguments:
  corpus

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --health-config HEALTH_CONFIG
                        Thresholds JSON (default: ./corpus_health.json, else
                        the repo root's; missing file skips the gate)
  --skip-health-gate    Report health violations but exit 0 on them
                        (experiments only)
